name: Kyushu Chuo Sanchi Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 九州中央山地国定公園
aliases: 九州中央山地国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of the Kyushu central mountains: the Mt. Ichifusa peaks and the Gokase river valleys of Kumamoto and Miyazaki.
notes: Managed by Kumamoto/Miyazaki. The Ichifusa trail and the Takachiho highlands frame the park.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
